Closed 2026-10-15 at Felix's request. The scope is covered: an archive checkbox for non-ongoing statuses, archiving several selected ideas at once through the multi-edit modal, archived ideas findable via the search picker's include-archived option, and merge_ideas archiving merged sources. Considered and not added: a one-click archive of every cancelled/failed idea (136 are unarchived). That is a judgment for each idea, not a missing feature.

Autonomous relevance check on 2026-07-30 found the sole implementation child, “Archive checkbox in edit idea - available when status is a halted status,” is done. Reconciled this finite umbrella from open to review rather than rebuilding completed work.
